findings.evidence: grep hits: `mathlib/Mathlib/Algebra/Category/CommHopfAlgCat.lean:72` defines `CommHopfAlgCat.ofHom` and `:94` has `hom_ext`; `mathlib/Mathlib/RingTheory/Bialgebra/Hom.lean:345` defines `unitBialgHom`, `:350` defines `counitBialgHom`, `:354` proves `counitBialgHom_apply`; the PR wrappers at `Trivial.lean:50`, `:56`, `:63`, `:71`, `:77`, `:83`, and `:88` are rfl/one-line restatements of exactly these.
findings.fix: Delete the ambient wrappers in `Trivial.lean`; in `FiniteTypeTrivial.lean` define the finite-type morphisms directly with `ObjectProperty.homMk (_root_.CommHopfAlgCat.ofHom (_root_.Bialgebra.unitBialgHom R H.obj))` and the analogous counit, and prove formulas by the existing Mathlib simp lemmas.
findings.issue: `CommHopfAlgCat.trivial`, `unit`, `counit`, and their unwrap/apply lemmas duplicate existing Mathlib API: `CommHopfAlgCat.of`, `CommHopfAlgCat.ofHom`, `Bialgebra.unitBialgHom`, `Bialgebra.counitBialgHom`, and `Bialgebra.counitBialgHom_apply`.

summary: The PR adds a parallel TauCeti `CommHopfAlgCat` trivial/unit/counit API that is only a thin wrapper around existing Mathlib bundled-category constructors and bialgebra maps. The finite-type declarations should use those existing declarations directly instead of introducing the ambient duplicate layer.
